root: ^No! Having fun with friends is more important, Napoleon!
^Don’t be ridiculous, Lump. This “fun” you talk about is a waste of time.
^Success is what matters and, when you’re having “fun”, you’re not achieving anything.
^You’re such a blowhole. Everyone needs balance!
^Lump here doesn’t know the right balance to life. That’s why he can’t get that contraption over there to open.
^But nothing is more important than beer.
^You’ll never learn. You need to make money then you can have beer.
^Such an interesting question. I‘ll come back to talk to them later
